falseSynonyms.zh: 小食不等於 fast food snack 是餐與餐之間或少量食物；快餐通常可以構成完整一餐。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A snack is small; fast food can be a full meal.

falseSynonyms.zh: 外賣不等於 fast food takeaway 描述購買後帶走的方式；外賣可以是任何菜系和價位。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Takeaway describes service mode, not food type.

falseSynonyms.zh: 即食餐不等於 fast food ready meal 多指超市／零售預製餐；fast food 常指快餐店快速供應的餐點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ready meals and fast food overlap but are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 垃圾食品不等於 fast food junk food 是營養評價；fast food 是供應形式或餐飲類別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Junk food concerns nutritional quality, not service speed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 街頭食品不等於 fast food street food 由街頭攤販出售；可以快速，也可以現場慢煮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Street food is defined by venue, not speed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 方便食品比 fast food 更廣 便利食品包括冷凍餐、罐頭、即食包裝食品等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Convenience food includes many products not sold by fast-food outlets.

falseSynonyms.zh: 加工食品不等於 fast food processed food 是加工程度分類，範圍非常廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Processing level and restaurant service format are different categories.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性與結構陷阱 fast 是形容詞／副詞；fast food 是固定名詞片語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fast describes speed; fast food names a food/service category.
